name: print-social-halftone-folder-banner-website
title: Halftone gradient banner with a folder and app icons
whatItIs: A wide banner with an orange to red to blue halftone dot texture. A manila folder labelled 'website' in serif sits centre with a pixel cursor, a blue scribble burst behind and app icons around.
whatItMeans: Nostalgic desktop meets modern zine; it says 'a folder of services' in a fun way.
techniques: Use a desktop metaphor (folder, cursor, app icons) to visualise a service category.
Apply coarse halftone over a gradient for tactile print grit.
Add a loose hand-drawn scribble to soften digital objects.
Label with an elegant serif to contrast with the icons.
bestFor: Service menu banners and channel headers

vocabulary.definition: A dot screen creating tone or texture.
Using folders and cursors as visual language.
A hand-drawn burst to add energy.
A wide header for a social profile or channel.
